title: Highlight Filter with a Forecast

div.h1: Highlight a part through a forecast
div.p: Pick a region. Each plan's subscriptions stay on the charts at their full value, faded in the stacked columns and dashed on the step line, and the region's share is drawn solid. The last three months are a forecast: the part keeps the forecast's dashes and lighter fill there too.
